responsibility: Provides WebAssembly ABI lowering for both clang-compatible C ABI and the legacy wasm-native ABI, including trivial aggregate unwrapping, indirect passing of nontrivial aggregates for the C ABI, integer widening, and direct aggregate-based lowering for the legacy multi-value ABI.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `asm/wasm.rs` and `spec/base/wasm.rs`, this WebAssembly file is about function-call ABI lowering, including the clang-compatible C ABI and the legacy wasm-native multi-value ABI, not the asm operand model or shared target options.
